svg.aria-label: Uptime of the bug tracker's parts from 3 to 16 November. On 11 November the API and Search were down for part of the day, and Sign-in was slow. Every other day was OK, except three short slow periods. Email alerts has no data for 14 November.

div.aria-label: The states of the status grid, columns 3 to 9
The states of the status grid, columns 10 to 16

ul.li: Each number is in %. A cell is OK at 99.9 or more, Warning from 99 to below 99.9, and Error below 99; a value on a threshold takes the better state. A cell with no state word is OK.
64 cells are OK, 3 are Warning and 2 are Error. 1 cell has no data.
